description: Gamify your life: complete quests, level up, build streaks. Turn your real life into a role-playing game. Life RPG lets you define your own quests, complete them, and watch your hero grow as you build better habits. Core gameplay * Create quests with 4 difficulty levels: Easy, Medium, Hard and Legendary * Earn XP, coins and climb the ranks as you complete your tasks * Build daily streaks and unlock streak milestones * Level up your hero and unlock new titles Your character * Customize your hero: hair, eyes, mouth, outfits, hats and accessories * See your character evolve as your hero progresses Stay motivated * Android home screen widgets: current quest, hero progress, quick add, daily quests and a monthly calendar * Notifications and daily reminders to keep your habits on track * A monthly calendar to visualize your tasks Deep gameplay systems * A skill tree to specialize your hero * A shop to spend your coins * Guilds, a leaderboard and referral codes to play with friends (online services are optional and disabled until configured) * Optional bets to add stakes to your habits * Weekly summaries and statistics to follow your progress Privacy first * Local game progress is stored on your device; online account synchronization is optional * Online features (guilds, chat, leaderboard, account sync and referrals) require an explicitly configured HTTPS Life RPG server and are disabled by default. When enabled, requests may include a persistent installation identifier. * No ads or third-party analytics; no account is required for local play Life RPG is free and open source software (GPL-3.0).
